mapper.sql: select p.product_id as productId, p.enterprise_id as enterpriseId, p.category_id as categoryId, p.product_code as productCode, p.product_name as productName, p.spec as spec, p.unit as unit, p.ref_price as refPrice, p.supplier_id as supplierId, p.status as status, p.del_flag as delFlag, p.remark as remark, p.image_url as imageUrl, p.create_time as createTime, p.update_time as updateTime, c.name as categoryName, ifnull(s.qty, 0) as stockQty, ifnull(s.qty, 0) - ifnull(s.locked_qty, 0) as availableQty from t_product p left join t_product_category c on c.category_id = p.category_id and c.enterprise_id = p.enterprise_id left join t_stock s on s.product_id = p.product_id and s.enterprise_id = p.enterprise_id
mapper.select: where p.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} and p.product_id = #{productId} and p.del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into t_product (enterprise_id, category_id, product_code, product_name, spec, unit, ref_price, supplier_id, status, remark, image_url, del_flag, create_by, create_time) values (#{enterpriseId}, #{categoryId}, #{productCode}, #{productName}, #{spec}, #{unit}, #{refPrice}, #{supplierId}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{imageUrl}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update t_product set status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} and product_id = #{productId}
update t_product set del_flag = '2', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} and product_id = #{productId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select count(1) from t_purchase_order_item i inner join t_purchase_order o on o.order_id = i.order_id where i.product_id = #{productId} and o.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} and o.del_flag = '0'
